headline: 22,000 passengers affected as 141 Saudi Arabia-bound flights disrupted
summary: Restrictions at Saudi airports due to Houthi attacks have led to the cancellation or suspension of both direct and transit flights from Bangladesh.
details: The Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh (CAAB) reported that 141 flights, including 66 direct and 75 transit flights, have been disrupted due to restrictions at Saudi Arabian airports.
A total of 21,933 passengers have been affected by these cancellations and suspensions.
Among the direct flights, Biman Bangladesh Airlines had 27 flights disrupted, Saudia Airlines 19, US-Bangla Airlines 10, and Riyadh Air 10.
Transit flight disruptions affected Indigo (29), Emirates (14), Qatar Airways (9), flydubai (8), Salam Air (7), Air India (7), and Egypt Air (1)
The disruptions began on October 11 following restrictions imposed by Saudi airports in response to attacks by the Houthi armed group from Yemen.
Biman Bangladesh Airlines has suspended flights to Riyadh and Dammam in three phases. Dammam-bound flights are cancelled until October 25, and Riyadh-bound flights are cancelled until October 31.
caption:

Transit flight disruptions affected Indigo (29), Emirates (14), Qatar Airways (9), flydubai (8), Salam Air (7), Air India (7), and Egypt Air (1)

The disruptions began on October 11 following restrictions imposed by Saudi airports in response to attacks by the Houthi armed group from Yemen.

Biman Bangladesh Airlines has suspended flights to Riyadh and Dammam in three phases. Dammam-bound flights are cancelled until October 25, and Riyadh-bound flights are cancelled until October 31.

headline: Father and 2-year-old daughter killed in Chattogram road crash
summary: A head-on collision between a bus and an auto-rickshaw in Satkania left two dead and five injured, sparking violent protests.
details: A 30-year-old man and his two-year-old daughter were killed and five others injured in a head-on collision between a passenger bus and a CNG-run auto-rickshaw in Satkania, Chattogram.

The victims, identified as Delwar and his daughter Jannat, were traveling to a fair at the upazila headquarters when the accident occurred near Jafar Ahmad Degree College on the Chattogram-Cox's Bazar highway.
Following the crash, angry locals set fire to the bus and blocked the highway, disrupting traffic for approximately 90 minutes.
The situation escalated when a police patrol vehicle was vandalized by the crowd, leaving one police member injured.
The Satkania Fire Service eventually brought the fire under control, and additional police forces were deployed to clear the blockade and restore traffic flow.
Police officials stated that legal action will be taken regarding the incident and the subsequent violence.
caption:
A father and his 2-year-old daughter were killed in a head-on collision in Chattogram. The tragedy sparked violent protests and the torching of a bus.

A 30-year-old man and his two-year-old daughter were killed and five others injured in a head-on collision between a passenger bus and a CNG-run auto-rickshaw in Satkania, Chattogram.

The victims, identified as Delwar and his daughter Jannat, were traveling to a fair at the upazila headquarters when the accident occurred near Jafar Ahmad Degree College on the Chattogram-Cox's Bazar highway.

Following the crash, angry locals set fire to the bus and blocked the highway, disrupting traffic for approximately 90 minutes.

The situation escalated when a police patrol vehicle was vandalized by the crowd, leaving one police member injured.

The Satkania Fire Service eventually brought the fire under control, and additional police forces were deployed to clear the blockade and restore traffic flow.

Police officials stated that legal action will be taken regarding the incident and the subsequent violence.
